note: Spirit states pass 1, on Wendell's 17:55 message opening the thread "Spirit satisfaction states". Exploratory: positions and one question, no art or code. Design ontology applied (QUICKSTART plus the game_design model's State, SatisfactionReport, TensionConfiguration, evidence table, rule 26). Eight ss-* positions; question ss-push-down survived the reach test. Dissent on the downward move: Shaman leans B, Regent and Diplomat A, Architect indifferent, Challenger asks him. No face subagents, no daemons.
steer: For the Sprits and Allies that we're working on for WAVE and Sprout game we need to also introduce the Satisfied, Dissatisfied, and Neutral versions of it in whatever intake it's coming in as. The creatures should be darker and more feral in dissatisfaction. We'll need to think through design markers that show the state. Downwind there will need to be moves that allow a player to shift a spriti from satisfied to dissatisfied OR in allied or creature state able to take on moves from other elements. This isn't fully thought out, but was something in my brain that I wanted to see how the 6 game masters and design ontology would handle.
